mapper.insert: insert into user_play_history ( user_id, subject_id, episode_id, episode_sort, subject_name, cover, alias, position_seconds, duration_seconds, is_completed, completed_at, last_played_at ) values ( #{row.userId}, #{row.subjectId}, #{row.episodeId}, #{row.episodeSort}, #{row.subjectName}, #{row.cover}, #{row.alias}, #{row.positionSeconds}, #{row.durationSeconds}, 0, null, current_timestamp ) on duplicate key update episode_id = #{row.episodeId}, episode_sort = #{row.episodeSort}, subject_name = #{row.subjectName}, cover = #{row.cover}, alias = #{row.alias}, position_seconds = #{row.positionSeconds}, duration_seconds = #{row.durationSeconds}, is_completed = 0, completed_at = null, last_played_at = current_timestamp
mapper.select: select id, subject_id, episode_id, episode_sort, subject_name, cover, alias, position_seconds, duration_seconds, is_completed, completed_at, last_played_at from user_play_history where user_id = #{userId} order by last_played_at desc, id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select id, subject_id, episode_id, episode_sort, subject_name, cover, alias, position_seconds, duration_seconds, is_completed, completed_at, last_played_at from user_play_history where user_id = #{userId} and subject_id = #{subjectId} limit 1
mapper.update: update user_play_history set position_seconds = 0, duration_seconds = 0, is_completed = 1, completed_at = current_timestamp, last_played_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{userId} and subject_id = #{subjectId}
